parts.name: Meter
parts.description: A labelled meter with a bounded visual value. Values must be finite and max must exceed min. Native div attributes and ref apply to the wrapper.

props.name: value
props.description: Finite measurement. Display and accessibility values are clamped to the configured range.

props.name: min
props.description: Finite lower bound; must be less than max.

props.name: max
props.description: Finite upper bound; must exceed min.

props.name: valueText
props.description: Custom visible value text and aria-valuetext. Otherwise the visible value is a percentage.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the value text beside the label; meter semantics remain when hidden.

props.name: tone
props.description: Meter palette: default ink or danger.

props.name: className
props.description: Additional classes applied to the component’s documented root or control.

props.name: id
props.description: DOM identifier for the rendered element.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref to the component’s documented DOM element.
